sources.title: Darius Slayton: Daniel Jones and I see field similarly, expect that to work well for us
sources.description: Darius Slayton was watching last Sunday night's game between the Colts and Chiefs, which meant he saw Colts wideout Alec Pierce leave the game after aggravating a heel injury.
